title: Effects of Early Vestibular Rehabilitation in Patients With Dizziness and Balance Disorders After Sport Concussion
brief_summary: This study examines the effect of early vestibular rehabilitation on reducing physical post-concussion symptoms (e.g. dizziness, balance problems) and improving the timeline to achieve medical clearance to return to activities such as sports and work activities. Half of the participants will receive early vestibular rehabilitation added to standard of care, while the other half will receive standard of care only.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Dizziness or balance problems within 10 days of concussion

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
